name: Gilded Chest
desc: Nicole's specialty. "Surprised? I already knew how to make this a long time ago. Well, back then..." "Lately, I heard from Mr. Nine that it's become popular again in Liyue..." "A treasure chest design, and a culinary icon all in one? I'm a genius..." As a golden "treasure chest" is set before you, a flood of nonstop chatter instantly fills your mind... It could only be Nicole. Your head may be left buzzing from the barrage, but the delight on your taste buds is even more rewarding than opening a luxurious treasure chest.
